personal.name: Tanveer Ahmed
personal.title: Supply Chain & Merchandising Professional
personal.subTitle: Master's in Apparel Merchandising (CBIFT) | BBA in Supply Chain Management (IIUC)
personal.bio: I am 25 years old, currently pursuing my Master's degree and seeking an entry-level position where I can begin my professional career. Although I am a fresher with no formal job experience, I am highly motivated, quick to learn, and confident in my abilities. I have strong leadership and organizational skills, which enable me to effectively organize and manage any task or activity with responsibility and dedication. I am eager to contribute my energy and potential to your esteemed organization.
personal.careerObjective: Seeking a dynamic entry-level role in Supply Chain & Apparel Merchandising within a premier RMG manufacturing or buying corporate environment. Eager to leverage hands-on training in Oracle ERP, supplier procurement, garment costing, and international order processing to optimize operational productivity and value.

experiences.summary: Completed rigorous hands-on corporate internship within one of Bangladesh's leading denim and apparel manufacturing exporters, gaining deep practical exposure in factory procurement operations.
responsibilities: Procurement & Supplier Evaluation: Selecting, evaluating, and shortlisting raw materials, trims, and accessory suppliers to ensure factory compliance and on-time delivery.
Purchasing Operations: Executing commercial purchases of industrial products and services adhering to budget limits and production schedules.
Transport & Inbound Logistics: Arranging, tracking, and coordinating the collection and timely dispatch of materials from external vendors to production floors.
Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP): Operating Oracle ERP for material requisition, purchase orders (PO), vendor databases, and inventory tracking.

education.institution: Chattogram BGMEA University of Fashion & Technology (CBIFT)
education.details: Comprehensive postgraduate curriculum focused on global apparel supply chain, merchandising strategies, fabric science, production flow, international buyer negotiations, and export-import compliance.
Four-year specialized business degree in Supply Chain Management covering logistics optimization, inventory control models, procurement strategies, statistical analysis, and operations management.
Disciplined academic foundation in business fundamentals, accounting principles, management, and commercial mathematics.
Secondary education with high distinction in business and analytical disciplines.
